output.summary: Harden host-runner failure recovery claim release behavior.

approvedRows.question: Should host-runner failed worker starts release claims automatically when appendReleases is explicitly enabled?
approvedRows.currentState: Worker start failures produced a release batch but did not append it even when appendReleases was enabled, so an explicitly recoverable failed start could leave a claim active until manual follow-up.
approvedRows.desiredState: When appendReleases is enabled, failed worker starts append the failed-start release batch, return the work item to ready, and still surface retry remediation. Cleanup failures remain visible after release append.
approvedRows.rationale: Autonomous recovery must avoid stuck claims while still surfacing host cleanup failures before the full implementation pipeline is enabled.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users avoid claimed work getting stuck after adapter/session startup failures.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get tests proving failed-start release and cleanup-failure behavior.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.
